newsitem.title: FRANCE: RESEARCH ALERT - Canal Plus rated "buy".
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Canal Plus rated "buy".

text.p: Brokers Lehman Brothers on Friday issued a "buy" on Canal Plus in a report which was initiating the broker's coverage of the stock.

Lehman's Carlo Campo Magnani said he had an objective of 1,360 francs for the share. He said the share was correctly valuing its French assets but was not fully reflecting the value of its foreign assets.
Canal Plus closed 2.69 percent lower at 978 francs on Friday after having hit a year low at 971 francs.
